classes/arcane-devotee-657.name: Reach of the Holy
classes/arcane-devotee-657.description: Apply Enlarge Spell to a spell without changing its slot or casting time. Daily uses equal 1 + Charisma modifier, minimum 1.

classes/arcane-devotee-657.name: Sacred Defense
classes/arcane-devotee-657.description: Gain +1 on saves against divine spells and outsider spell-like or supernatural abilities; the bonus becomes +2 at 4th level.

classes/arcane-devotee-657.name: Divine Synergy
classes/arcane-devotee-657.description: A harmless spell cast on you by another divine caster of your patron deity is empowered when Empower Spell can affect it.

classes/arcane-devotee-657.name: Divine Shroud
classes/arcane-devotee-657.description: Once per day surround yourself with divine power that functions like spell resistance, using your arcane caster level.

classes/argent-savant-224.name: Force Specialization
classes/argent-savant-224.description: Gain +2 on attack rolls with force spells and add +1 damage per damage die, or +1 total when the spell does not roll damage dice.

classes/argent-savant-224.name: Force Armor
classes/argent-savant-224.description: When you cast a force spell that grants an armor or shield AC bonus, increase that bonus by 2.

classes/argent-savant-224.name: Enduring Force
classes/argent-savant-224.description: Your force spells have doubled duration without a higher slot or longer casting time, and the DC to counter or dispel them increases by 4.

classes/argent-savant-224.name: Ablate Force
classes/argent-savant-224.description: Reduce force damage you take by your argent savant class level; a multi-hit force spell counts as one attack for this reduction.

classes/argent-savant-224.name: Unbind Force
classes/argent-savant-224.description: As a standard action, attempt to dispel one force effect within 60 feet. A successful caster-level check ends it and releases force damage around it.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Improved Unarmed Strike
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Strike the Weak Spot
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: As a standard action attack an unattended object; after a hit, a Concentration check can let that attack ignore the object's hardness.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Evasion
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: On a successful Reflex save for half damage, take no damage while wearing light armor or no armor.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Combat Instinct
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: Gain +1 insight to AC and initiative at 3rd level, improving to +2 at 6th and +3 at 9th.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Bonus Feat
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: Choose a listed bonus feat at 4th level and another at 8th level, meeting its prerequisites.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Combination Strike
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: After confirming a melee critical hit, immediately attempt a disarm or sunder against that opponent as a free action.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Improved Evasion
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save for half and only half damage on a failed save; helpless characters do not benefit.

classes/cipher-adept-688.name: Move Without Barriers
classes/cipher-adept-688.description: Become ethereal for a daily total of 1 + Wisdom modifier rounds, minimum 1; the rounds need not be consecutive.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Climb Speed
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Gain a climb speed that begins at 10 feet and increases by 10 feet at each odd class level; the benefit is lost in armor or with a medium or heavy load.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Wisdom of the Mountain
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Add Wisdom modifier on Balance, Climb, and Jump checks in mountain terrain and may take 10 on those skills even when normally prevented.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Slow Breath
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Hold breath twice as long and gain +2 on specified Fortitude saves against inhaled poison and altitude hazards; the save bonus becomes +6 at 6th level.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Bonus Feat
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Choose a listed bonus feat at 3rd level and again at 7th level, meeting its prerequisites.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Resistance to Cold
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Gain cold resistance 5 at 4th level, increasing to cold resistance 10 at 8th level.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Fast Movement
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Gain +10 feet land speed at 4th level and +20 feet at 8th while unarmored and not carrying a medium or heavy load.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Empty Stride
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Walk over surfaces you would normally sink into while maintaining the required Concentration check; the check normally uses a standard action and can be maintained as a move action at higher DC.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Improved Slow Breath
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: The Slow Breath saving-throw bonus improves to +6 against inhaled poisons, high-elevation fatigue, and altitude sickness.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Acrobatic Charge
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Charge across difficult terrain that would normally prevent a charge, making movement checks required by specific obstacles.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Walk on the Clouds
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Empty Stride can be maintained as a free action, and once per day you can use air walk as a quickened spell-like ability.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Immortality of the Mountain
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: You no longer die of old age, ignore altitude sickness and thin-air fatigue, and gain +2 sacred on Wisdom checks and saves in mountain terrain.

classes/cloud-anchorite-499.name: Monk Abilities
classes/cloud-anchorite-499.description: Cloud anchorite levels stack with monk levels to determine unarmed damage and the monk AC bonus.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Kid Gloves
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Deal lethal or nonlethal weapon damage interchangeably without the normal -4 attack penalty.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Special Dispensation
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: While bounty hunting is accepted locally, a slavers guild is present, or an influential patron supports you, gain the benefit of the Special Dispensation feat without its prerequisites.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Swift Tracker
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Starting at 2nd level, make Urban Tracking Gather Information checks every half-hour without the usual -5 penalty.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Painful Strike
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: A qualifying melee attack that deals nonlethal damage to an unarmed foe deals +1d6 nonlethal damage at 3rd level, +2d6 at 6th, and +3d6 at 9th.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Immovable Heart
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Gain +2 competence on saves against enchantment spells and fear effects.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Improved Disarm
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Gain Improved Disarm as a bonus feat without needing its prerequisites.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Threaten
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Demoralize an opponent as a move action; success lasts for Strength modifier rounds, minimum 1, and you gain +2 on the Intimidate check.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Deadened Hide
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Become immune to nonlethal damage and to effects that inflict or manipulate pain.

classes/crimson-scourge-262.name: Smell of Blood
classes/crimson-scourge-262.description: Gain scent and a +3 insight bonus on initiative checks.

classes/divine-champion-661.name: Lay on Hands
classes/divine-champion-661.description: Heal yourself or a creature with the same patron deity by touch as a paladin's lay on hands; the class-derived healing pool is based on divine champion level and Charisma bonus.

classes/divine-champion-661.name: Bonus Feat
classes/divine-champion-661.description: Choose a listed bonus feat at 2nd level and another at 4th level, meeting its prerequisites.

classes/divine-champion-661.name: Sacred Defense
classes/divine-champion-661.description: Gain +1 on saves against divine spells and outsider spell-like or supernatural abilities; the bonus improves to +2 at 4th level.

classes/divine-champion-661.name: Smite Infidel
classes/divine-champion-661.description: Once per day make a melee smite against a creature with a different patron deity, adding Charisma bonus to the attack and class level to damage.

classes/divine-champion-661.name: Divine Wrath
classes/divine-champion-661.description: Once per day gain damage reduction 5/-, plus +3 on attacks, damage, and saves for Charisma modifier rounds, minimum 1.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Lolth's Will
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Your racial Will-save bonus against spells and spell-like abilities increases to +4.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Lolth's Whispers
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Gain +2 insight on damage rolls; as a swift action you can give up the bonus to grant it to a visible ally within 30 feet for 1 round.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Sudden Strike
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Deal extra precision damage when a target is denied Dexterity to AC; the bonus begins at +1d6 and increases by +1d6 at each later odd class level.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Poison Use
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Never risk accidentally poisoning yourself when applying poison to a weapon.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Team Maneuverability
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Add half class level as an insight bonus on Climb and Jump; visible allies within 30 feet gain +2 competence on those checks.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Retain Dexterity bonus to AC when flat-footed or attacked by an unseen foe; if already possessed, gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Improved Evasion
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save for half and only half damage on a failed save.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Team Defense
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Gain +1 dodge AC, improving to +2 at 8th level; as a swift action you can give up the bonus and grant it to a visible ally within 30 feet for 1 round.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Spider Bite
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: The save DC against the initial effect of poison delivered by your poisoned weapon increases by 2.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Opportunist
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: Once per round make an attack of opportunity against an opponent just damaged in melee by another character.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: You can no longer be flanked except by a sufficiently higher-level rogue, following the standard improved uncanny dodge interaction.

classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.name: Ambush
classes/dread-fang-of-lolth-428.description: During a surprise round, act normally if aware of opponents; if surprised, you can still take a standard action.

classes/escalation-mage-467.name: The Shade Within
classes/escalation-mage-467.description: At 1st level permanently gain hit points equal to 1 + Charisma modifier, minimum 1, then gain 1 additional hit point at each later class level.

classes/escalation-mage-467.name: Escalation
classes/escalation-mage-467.description: You have escalation uses per day equal to class level. Normally as a swift action, spend a use to apply the unlocked Shadow Focus, Power, Growth, or Haste effect to the next spell within 1 round, accepting that mode's caster-level check and failure cost.

classes/escalation-mage-467.name: Soul of Shadow
classes/escalation-mage-467.description: Each day you may use each of the four escalation modes once without its caster-level check, in addition to normal escalation uses, but not on your highest available arcane spell level.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Aura of Truth
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Creatures within 20 feet must save or be unable to speak falsehoods, functioning like zone of truth with a DC based on class level and Charisma.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Blindsense
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Gain blindsense 10 feet at 1st level, increasing by 10 feet at 4th, 7th, and 9th levels.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Lolth's Vision
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Add class level to Spot checks; as a swift action grant that bonus to an ally within 30 feet for 1 round.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Sneak Attack
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack at 2nd level, increasing to +2d6 at 5th and +3d6 at 8th.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Teamwork Observation
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: After studying one target for 1 minute, you and allies within 30 feet gain +2 on attack and weapon damage against it for 5 rounds; the bonus becomes +4 at 7th level.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Hide in Plain Sight
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: While within 10 feet of a shadow, you can use Hide even while observed.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Team Sense
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Gain +2 insight on initiative and Listen, Search, and Spot checks; allies within 30 feet gain the same bonus.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Team Stealth
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: Reduce fast-movement penalties on Hide and Move Silently; as a swift action grant this benefit to a character within 30 feet for 1 round.

classes/eye-of-lolth-429.name: Vanish
classes/eye-of-lolth-429.description: As a swift action become invisible for 5 rounds. The ability is at will but cannot be used again until 1 minute has passed.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Spin Fate
classes/fatespinner-211.description: Each day gain spin points equal to fatespinner level; as a free action spend any number to raise the save DC of a spell by the same amount.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Fickle Finger of Fate
classes/fatespinner-211.description: Once per day as an immediate action force another visible creature to reroll a roll it just made and use the new result.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Spin Destiny
classes/fatespinner-211.description: You can spend the same Spin Fate pool before rolling to add spin points one-for-one to your own attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Deny Fate
classes/fatespinner-211.description: Once per day, the first stabilization check you would make while dying automatically succeeds.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Resist Fate
classes/fatespinner-211.description: Once per day reroll one roll you just made and keep the second result.

classes/fatespinner-211.name: Seal Fate
classes/fatespinner-211.description: Once per day as a free action choose a visible creature within 30 feet with no more Hit Dice than you; its next save within 1 round gains +10 or suffers -10.

classes/fist-of-raziel-145.name: Magic Circle
classes/fist-of-raziel-145.description: You are continuously surrounded by a magic circle against evil effect using your character level as caster level.

classes/fist-of-raziel-145.name: Smite Evil
classes/fist-of-raziel-145.description: Smite evil uses increase from 1/day at 1st level to 5/day at 9th. The smite adds Charisma to the attack and class level to damage, with additional good-aligned, confirming, holy, fiendsmite, and chain benefits as class level rises.

classes/fist-of-raziel-145.name: Sanctify Martial Strike
classes/fist-of-raziel-145.description: Gain Sanctify Martial Strike as a bonus feat at 4th level.

classes/fist-of-raziel-145.name: Sunder Evil Item
classes/fist-of-raziel-145.description: Deal double damage when attacking an evil object or evil construct; this does not stack with Great Sunder.

classes/fist-of-raziel-145.name: Holy Martial Strike
classes/fist-of-raziel-145.description: At 10th level, any weapon you wield is treated as holy and deals +2d6 damage to evil creatures, subject to the stated nonstacking rules.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Earth's Defender
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Once per day as a move action give one wielded weapon a temporary enhancement bonus for 1 minute per character level: +1 at 1st, +2 at 3rd, +3 at 5th; it does not stack with an existing enhancement bonus.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Fast Movement
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Base land speed increases by 10 feet and stacks with fast movement from other sources.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Nature's Rejuvenation
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: After 1 minute touching a living plant or fertile ground, affect yourself as bear's endurance, cure moderate wounds, or lesser restoration. Uses are 1/day, 2/day at 3rd, and 3/day at 5th.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Woodland Stride
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Move through natural overgrowth at normal speed without harm; if you already have woodland stride, gain +10 feet land speed instead.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Swift Tracker
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Follow tracks at normal movement speed; if already possessed, lessen the tracking penalties by an additional 5.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Camouflage
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Use Hide in any natural terrain even while being observed.

classes/forest-reeve-227.name: Whispers of the Forest
classes/forest-reeve-227.description: Once per day ask a simple question about current events in wilderness on your land mass and receive a short answer through the surrounding natural world.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Favored Enemy (Giant)
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Gain +2 on specified skills and weapon damage against giants; the bonus increases by +2 every three class levels and stacks with ranger favored enemy (giant).

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Crafty Fighter
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Gain +4 dodge AC against giants or +2 against other creatures at least two sizes larger; the benefit is lost when Dexterity to AC is lost or while in heavy armor.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Slippery
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Add class level on checks to escape a grapple by a creature at least two sizes larger and may move through such creatures' spaces when physically possible.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Close Shot
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Using a ranged weapon while threatened by a giant does not provoke attacks of opportunity from that giant.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Fast Movement
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Gain +10 feet base land speed while in no, light, or medium armor and not carrying a heavy load.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Improved Mobility
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Gain +4 dodge AC while moving out of or within a giant's threatened area; this stacks with Mobility.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Annoying Strike
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Whenever you damage a giant in melee, that giant is shaken for 1 round.

classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.name: Defensive Roll
classes/gnome-giant-slayer-314.description: Once per day when a giant's weapon or blow would reduce you to 0 or fewer hit points, make a Reflex save against the damage with class level added; success halves the damage.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Might of Darkness
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Cast spells with the darkness descriptor at +2 caster level.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Eyes of Night
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Gain darkvision 60 feet, see through magical darkness out to 10 feet, and cannot be blinded by magical effects.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Shadow Talk
classes/nightcloak-971.description: As a free action whisper a short mental message heard by worshipers of your patron deity within 500 feet; nearby observers may hear the actual whisper.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: True Lies
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Once per day modify a creature's memories as modify memory, using character level as caster level and the class's stated save DC.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Grace of the Dark
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Add your Intelligence bonus, if any, to all saving throws.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Minions of Night
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Once per week as a standard action summon one shadow per nightcloak level for a number of rounds equal to class level; shadows they create disappear with them.

classes/nightcloak-971.name: Voice of Ineffable Evil
classes/nightcloak-971.description: Once per day command a creature as dominate monster for up to 24 hours, using character level as caster level; this spell-like ability has a verbal component.

classes/stormtalon-746.name: Foot Talons
classes/stormtalon-746.description: While airborne, your sharpened foot talons are natural weapons you are proficient with, dealing 1d6 plus Strength and usable as a secondary attack during a weapon full attack.

classes/stormtalon-746.name: Bonus Aerial Feat
classes/stormtalon-746.description: At every even class level choose one feat from the stormtalon's aerial feat list.

classes/stormtalon-746.name: Fast Flight
classes/stormtalon-746.description: Increase racial fly speed by 10 feet at 3rd level, 20 feet at 5th, and 40 feet at 9th, following the restrictions of barbarian fast movement.

classes/stormtalon-746.name: Improved Foot Talons
classes/stormtalon-746.description: Foot talons improve to 1d8 damage and can be used even while not flying.

classes/sword-of-righteousness-155.name: Bonus Exalted Feat
classes/sword-of-righteousness-155.description: At each class level choose one bonus feat whose feat type is Exalted.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Horrors of Thay
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: Gain +2 morale on saves against fear and +1 against charm, improving at 4th level to +4 and +2; these bonuses do not apply against Red Wizards.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Zulkir's Favor
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: A magical tattoo grants +2 resistance on Reflex saves and +2 morale on Intimidate while visible, but you automatically fail saves against mind-affecting spells cast by a Red Wizard.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Zulkir's Defender
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: Gain +2 morale on attack and damage against a creature that attacks you or that you have seen attack a Red Wizard.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Fighter Feat
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: At 3rd level choose a fighter bonus feat other than Weapon Specialization.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Final Stand
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: Once per day as a standard action grant 2d10 temporary hit points to nearby allies; the number affected and duration both equal class level + Charisma modifier.

classes/thayan-knight-337.name: Zulkir's Champion
classes/thayan-knight-337.description: Once per day add +2 luck to one saving throw after seeing the roll; the visible champion tattoo also raises the Intimidate morale bonus to +4.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Flourish
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: While in light or no armor, add blade bravo class level to Bluff checks made to feint in combat.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Goad
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: Gain Goad as a bonus feat; with at least 5 Bluff ranks, the save DC against Goad increases by 2.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Mobile Fighting
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: After moving at least 5 feet, gain +1 dodge AC until your next turn while in light or no armor and while retaining Dexterity to AC.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Bonus Feat
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: Choose a listed combat-oriented bonus feat at 3rd, 6th, and 9th levels, meeting its prerequisites.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Melee Sneak Attack
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: Deal +1d6 sneak attack damage with melee attacks at 4th level and +2d6 at 8th when the target qualifies for sneak attack; it stacks with other sneak attack only in melee.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Size Advantage
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: While in light or no armor, gain +2 dodge AC per size category by which an attacking foe is larger than you.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Small but Deadly
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: Gain +4 on rolls to confirm melee critical hits against creatures larger than you.

classes/blade-bravo-726.name: Lethal Riposte
classes/blade-bravo-726.description: Once per round while in light or no armor, a foe that misses you with a melee attack provokes an attack of opportunity and loses Dexterity to AC against that attack.
